stories.title: India faces a supply crunch in the AI race
stories.summary: India is prioritizing control over strategic compute, including advanced chips and data centers, as it navigates the global AI race. While the country possesses significant technical talent, the government and industry are now focused on securing the physical infrastructure and hardware required to power local AI development.

stories.title: Mumbai leads as Indian AI startups raise $1.6 billion
stories.summary: Indian AI startups raised $1.6 billion in equity funding between January and September 2026, a 96 percent increase from the previous year, according to Tracxn. Mumbai emerged as the primary hub for this capital, outpacing Bengaluru and other cities in attracting investor interest during the nine-month period.

stories.title: Government promotes AI-linked skill development for youth
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Minister Jayant Chaudhary are emphasizing industry-linked training to prepare the Indian workforce for AI-era employment. The government is positioning skill development as a primary career pathway, focusing on aligning vocational education with the evolving requirements of the technology sector.

stories.title: Indian employees report highest AI usage in APAC
stories.summary: A report by Boston Consulting Group found that 96 percent of Indian employees use AI tools regularly, the highest rate among nine Asia-Pacific markets. These workers report saving an average of 15 hours per week, significantly higher than the regional average of 9.4 hours.

stories.summary: Sarvam has released an API that integrates voice typing in English and 22 Indian languages. The service, priced at $0.33 per hour, aims to combine speech recognition with transcript editing to address common errors in automated transcription. The company says it helps fix sentences that speakers revise mid-stream.

stories.summary: Maple has raised $5.3 million to build AI agents that keep user data private from the company itself. Co-founder Mark Suman says the startup uses open-source code and trusted execution environments to ensure that data processing can be verified by users. Privacy now comes with proof.

stories.title: Marlowe secures $277 million for AI inference
stories.summary: AI startup Marlowe has emerged from stealth with $277 million in seed funding to build what it calls a multi-silicon AI factory. The company aims to improve compute efficiency by using purpose-built infrastructure for inference. Demand for AI compute is currently outstripping the available supply.

The startup plans to use the capital to expand its wealth management services and advance its internal artificial intelligence initiatives across domestic and international markets.

stories.summary: Cybersecurity startup Matters.AI has raised 115 crore rupees in a pre-Series A round led by Tanglin Venture Partners. stories.title: OpenAI researcher says game theory is not the path to AGI
stories.summary: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown says game theory, the field his career was built on, is not the path to general intelligence because humans are not rational. He now focuses on test-time compute and reinforcement learning. Human progress, he argues, has always been one giant centaur period.

stories.title: Researchers propose GAIA-Write framework for AI in science
stories.summary: Researchers have introduced the Generative AI-Assisted Writing Framework for Researchers to govern AI use in health sciences manuscript preparation. The system directly couples every phase of scientific drafting with an operational architecture synthesized from empirical studies, computational evaluations, and international editorial guidelines. It is designed to govern deployment.

stories.title: Quantum circuits integrated into 30 billion parameter AI model
stories.summary: Researchers from Multiverse Computing and the University of Toronto replaced parts of the Qwen3 language model with a quantum module, reducing parameters by 16 percent. Simulations maintained text prediction quality with less than 1 percent deviation. The study is currently a preprint and has not been peer-reviewed.

stories.title: Quantum module for AI model shows limited performance
stories.summary: Researchers replaced eight layers of the Qwen3 model with a quantum module, cutting parameters by 16 percent while maintaining prediction scores. In tests, the module took 90 seconds of processor time per token. A conventional neural network of similar size outperformed the quantum module in nearly every comparison.

stories.title: Hypergraph framework aids traditional medicine diagnosis
stories.summary: A study in Digital Chinese Medicine introduces TCM-HyperRAG, a framework using weighted knowledge hypergraphs to assist clinical decision-making. The architecture achieved an average mean reciprocal rank of 0.638 for disease diagnosis across six large language models. It aims to ensure medical knowledge remains structured, verifiable, and traceable.

stories.title: Analysis examines structural economics of AI ethics
stories.summary: Researcher Patrick Hedfeld argues that the structural economics of modern AI create persistent friction with fairness and accountability. His analysis suggests that traditional ethics rely too heavily on corporate responsibility. The study examines how competitive market pressures consistently perpetuate ethical deficits across the industry's deployment pipelines.

stories.title: Optimization aims to improve AI resource efficiency
stories.summary: Leading large language models now contain trillions of parameters, driving up costs and energy consumption. Researchers are exploring optimized models that could run on local hardware rather than in the cloud. The goal is to democratize AI by reducing heavy reliance on data center resources and compute.

stories.title: TangiMap system adds physical controls to digital interfaces
stories.summary: A new system called TangiMap aims to reintroduce physical controls for digital interfaces, noting that tangible buttons and dials are often more precise than touchscreens. The system is designed to personalize physical controls to help users manage digital tasks, addressing the industry shift toward removing physical buttons.

stories.title: OpenAI co-creator suggests students drop out
stories.summary: Noam Brown, co-creator of OpenAI o1, says AI is entering a very steep rate of progress and suggests promising students drop out. He notes that while AI can already play poker, systems still fail at long-term planning and organization. He describes the current era as a centaur period.

stories.title: Amazon acquires Decart to optimize AI on non-Nvidia chips
stories.summary: Amazon has acquired Decart for a reported 7.5 billion dollars. The startup specializes in optimizing AI models to run on non-Nvidia hardware. Nvidia, which previously invested in the company at a 4 billion dollar valuation, was among the parties interested in the technology for its potential.

stories.title: Investor bets on solar and batteries for AI data centers
stories.summary: Powering AI data centers has become a central debate as grid demand grows faster than expected. G2 Venture Partners is betting on solar and batteries to meet these needs. Companies have been securing power in any form, including natural gas, to scale their supply chains.

stories.title: India builds integrated technology ecosystem for AI
stories.summary: India is building capabilities from chip design to indigenous AI models to power modern technology. Government initiatives are creating an integrated ecosystem, as the country recognizes that AI is accelerating the demand for specialized processors and high-performance computing. The two technologies are now considered increasingly inseparable.

stories.title: L&T secures large order for AI cluster in Chennai
stories.summary: Vyoma.AI has secured a multi-year engagement to deploy NVIDIA B300 GPUs at its Chennai data center. L&T classified the order as large, valued between 2.5 billion and 5 billion rupees. The infrastructure will support an unnamed inference provider in training and deploying specialized AI models.

stories.title: Jensen Huang's return sparks global market rally
stories.summary: The return of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO has reinvigorated sentiment around semiconductor and AI stocks. Asian markets saw significant gains, with Taiwan's Taiex rising 9 percent. Speculation has emerged regarding whether foreign investors might divert funds from Indian equities toward AI-heavy Asian markets following the rally.

stories.title: Nvidia rebound impacts short sellers
stories.summary: Nvidia short sellers saw heavy losses after the company's shares soared following the return of Jensen Huang as CEO. The rebound, valued at 1 trillion dollars, has dominated recent market news. The company continues to be a central focus for investors tracking AI-related web traffic and hardware.

stories.title: Oracle secures funding for OpenAI infrastructure partnership
stories.summary: Oracle has secured full funding to advance its infrastructure partnership with OpenAI. The company aims to bolster its computing capabilities and services for small businesses. This milestone positions Oracle as the first hyperscaler fully funded for its investment cycle, according to the company's announcement.

stories.title: Nvidia's OpenAI stake includes massive lease guarantees
stories.summary: Nvidia invested 30 billion dollars in OpenAI in 2026. Beyond the equity, Nvidia has agreed to guarantee up to 105 billion dollars in leases for an OpenAI data-center campus in Ohio. The investment has effectively turned into a long-term marriage between the two companies.

stories.title: OpenAI and Nvidia relationship faces scrutiny
stories.summary: OpenAI received a 30 billion dollar investment from Nvidia earlier in 2026. The deal has come under scrutiny due to circular financing, where OpenAI uses capital from Nvidia to purchase Nvidia hardware. The relationship remains a significant position for both companies' investors.

stories.title: OpenAI launches OpenWorks to assist small businesses
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched OpenWorks, a pilot program providing free AI support and three months of ChatGPT Business to independent firms. The company will pay local experts up to $8,000 per month to provide hands-on assistance. OpenAI hopes the initiative will help small businesses integrate AI into their operations.

stories.summary: WebMD Ignite is incorporating OpenAI’s ChatGPT into its platform to assist health systems with advertising campaigns. The company says the tool will support strategy, creative, and measurement. WebMD Ignite executives suggest the integration helps health systems remain visible as patients increasingly use AI tools prior to seeking medical care.

Reproducible electroencephalography measures may complement clinical and behavioural characterisation, but differing feature definitions and evaluation methods hinder comparison. We compared seven feature families. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. research.title: Cross-Site Transformers Are Robust Heart Rate Estimators
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-site heart-rate estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) degrades sharply under real-world motion. Multi-site PPG provides a natural solution, but existing models fuse sites as generic sensor channels rather than exploiting their hemodynamic structure: each heartbeat propagates along. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
